text:
Cobalt, manganese and chromium are all metals.
Cobalt(II) oxide reacts with carbon to form cobalt metal.
●
Manganese(II) oxide does not react with carbon.
●
Chromium(II) oxide does not react with carbon.
●
●
Chromium does not react with water.
●
Manganese reacts with water.
